followup_budget.trigger: Unexplained process-median frame/GPU spread above 3 percent or p95/p99 above 15 percent
followup_budget.invalid_attempts: Retain. At most one replacement per selected operation; recurring external failure blocks dependent evidence.

repeatability_gate.scope: Observed range only, not confidence interval; source, trace, settings, cache, focus and endpoint must match.

method.performance_claim: Baseline and attribution only; no delivered runtime gain.

cpu_scope_contract: Microseconds per recorded invocation. Simulation and animation_tick are fixed ticks; pose/camera/effects are render updates; stream scopes are events. Nested scopes overlap and must not be summed.
percentile_contract: Each run retains its own percentile; aggregate values are medians of run statistics, never pooled percentiles.
